title: 广东糖水①杨枝甘露：这碗芒果甜品，其实只有40岁 | Canton Sweet Soups P1 · Mango Pomelo Sago 🥭
description:
你更爱芒果多一点，还是柚子多一点？

广东糖水 第①集 · 杨枝甘露。看着像老派港式甜品，它其实很「年轻」——据传1984年才在香港利苑酒家出现，是一次「剩料改造」：撈起鱼生后剩下大量柚子肉，点心部索性把它拌进芒果西米露，成了这碗消暑冷甜品。芒果打成泥、西米煮到透明、柚子粒一咬就爆；名字由酒家总监取自观音「以杨柳枝洒下甘露」的意象。40年后，它成了几乎每家糖水铺的顶流。

It looks like an old-school Hong Kong classic, but mango-pomelo sago (yeung chi gam lo) is barely 40 years old — reportedly first served at Hong Kong's Lei Garden around 1984, when the kitchen folded leftover pomelo from a raw-fish feast into mango sago. Mango is puréed, sago boiled until clear, and pomelo pearls pop between your teeth. The name evokes Guanyin sprinkling sweet dew from a willow branch. Four decades on, it's the top seller at nearly every Cantonese dessert shop.
